title: Human Review for AI-Generated Articles: The Minimum Bar Before You Hit Publish
description: The editorial pass that catches weak claims, repetition, and machine-like phrasing before AI-assisted content goes live.
excerpt: Automation is powerful, but publishing without review usually creates the exact thin content problems that ad platforms and readers both reject.
author: MyAppAI Editorial

sections.heading: Why this matters
sections.body: Review should validate claims, remove repetition, and tighten the promise of the article.

sections.heading: How the workflow should be structured
sections.body: Any paragraph that could fit on every site in the category probably should be rewritten or removed.

sections.heading: What to automate and what to review
sections.body: Editorial polish often comes from examples, concrete framing, and stronger transitions, not more words.

sections.heading: Where this creates revenue leverage
sections.body: A trustworthy publication needs a visible standard for what gets published and what stays in draft.
